name: aicode-web
description: Aicode 运营控制台（微前端：Vite + Module Federation）

scripts.dev: concurrently -n host,product,user -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @mfe/host" "npm run dev -w @mfe/product" "npm run dev -w @mfe/user"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mfe/product && npm run build -w @mfe/user && npm run build -w @mfe/host
scripts.preview: concurrently -n host,product,user -c blue,green,magenta "npm run preview -w @mfe/host" "npm run preview -w @mfe/product" "npm run preview -w @mfe/user"
